approved_lines.core_claim: The supervisor-facing surface should put team, assignee_cell, return_slot, and paperclip_reference_line ahead of report prose because those fields are the operating handles for the next transition.
evidence_basis: internal_read_report line seed routing_fields_first cites Codex candidate 1, API team_registry, assignment persistence, handoff selected_context_summary, and the Paperclip IssueProperties reference line.

app/runtime/vectorfl_integrated_engine_api.py defines team_registry report slots and create_vectorfl_integrated_engine_assignment persists team_id, assignee_cell, expected_report, forbidden_scope, and return_slot.
app/runtime/vectorfl_integrated_engine_shell.py exposes team and assignee selection in the assignment form and target team in the supervisor route form.
approved_lines.human_translation: Before a supervisor reads a long report, they need to see who owns the packet, where the return is expected, and which Paperclip-style operating line is being followed.
approved_lines.next_use: Use as a UI/order rule for the next supervisor-approved implementation brief: routing fields should be treated as primary controls, not metadata under the report body.

approved_lines.core_claim: The operating spine should remain work packet -> team assignment -> worker report -> supervisor gate.

approved_lines.human_translation: The page should read like responsibility moving through a chain, not like a collection of status panels.
approved_lines.next_use: Use as the main structure for any next page or implementation brief work.

approved_lines.core_claim: Worker report areas must keep saying that bridge output is read-only evidence return, not product execution, implementation completion, slot replacement, or gate closure.
evidence_basis: supervisor_route guard preserves does_not_replace_current_slot, does_not_close_gate, does_not_promote_candidate, and records_supervisor_route_only.
internal_read_report line seed read_only_report_not_execution cites the Codex blockers, API guard fields, assignment forbidden_scope, and shell copy.
docs/reports/vectorfl_integrated_engine_worker_execution_loop_log_v0.md says the loop is bounded and read-only at the worker level and is not slot replacement, gate close, or full orchestration.
approved_lines.human_translation: Completed means a report returned. It must not look like the underlying product work is done.
approved_lines.next_use: Use as mandatory copy and state semantics for worker report, internal read, and synthesis run areas.

approved_lines.core_claim: The system should keep repeated pressure, stable/unclear boundaries, next questions, and line seeds separate before forming implementation tasks.
evidence_basis: docs/contracts/vectorfl_paper_synthesis_cell_v0.md forbids claiming confirmation without evidence or collapsing the loop into done too early.

internal_read_report line seed evidence_sections_before_tasks cites the internal-read contract, conversation-to-line procedure, Codex candidate 4, shell internal-read sections, and API internal_read output schema.
app/runtime/vectorfl_integrated_engine_shell.py renders stable, unclear, next questions, and line seeds as separate internal-read report fields.
approved_lines.human_translation: Do not turn the reread into a TODO list until the supervisor can inspect what evidence produced each line.
approved_lines.next_use: Use as the structure for supervisor_report_latest and any later implementation brief handoff.
